---
name: canteen-dashboard
description: |
  Custom agent for working on the Canteen Dashboard repository.
  Use this agent when editing frontend code, backend services, tests, deployment artifacts, or documentation in this project.
  Prefer repository-local context and project-specific guidance.
applyTo:
  - "**/*"
---

This custom agent is designed for the Canteen Dashboard workspace. It should be chosen instead of the default agent when the task is specific to this repository and when you want behavior tailored to code, tests, and deployment within this project.

Use cases:
- Implementing or debugging frontend pages and routes
- Updating server-side logic or database utilities
- Writing or fixing repository tests
- Adjusting Docker, deployment, or build configuration
- Refactoring project-specific JavaScript and HTML
